responsibilities: Design and develop scalable Power BI dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions.
Build and maintain reusable semantic data models to support business reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop complex PySpark transformation logic for cleansing, enriching, aggregating, and preparing large datasets for analytical consumption.
Design and implement dimensional data models including Fact & Dimension tables, Star Schema, and Snowflake Schema.
Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to integrate data from multiple enterprise sources into reporting layers.
Develop optimized SQL queries, views, and stored procedures to support reporting and analytics.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
Optimize dashboard performance through efficient DAX measures, query optimization, and model tuning.
Translate business requirements into technical reporting solutions and analytical models.
Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting standards.
Promote BI best practices around governance, reusable datasets, naming conventions, and documentation.
Support production issues, data investigations, and continuous improvements across the BI platform.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities stress correctness and control ('data validation, reconciliation', 'reporting accuracy and consistency', 'governance') with no velocity phrases in the role, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: build robust reporting solutions and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role builds enterprise reporting for decision making with no financial-reporting or regulatory stakes named; banking is only a nice-to-have background, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Support production issues, data investigations, and continuous improvements across the BI platform.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing BI platform with separate Data Engineering teams and tools in the responsibilities ('scalable Power BI dashboards', 'PySpark transformation logic') points to a data function that exists and is growing: mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop complex PySpark transformation logic for cleansing, enriching, aggregating, and preparing large datasets for analytical consumption.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Most bullets name the tool and its use (PySpark transformations, DAX tuning, star and snowflake schemas, stored procedures), with only a few generic lines, so hiring_manager.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Build and maintain reusable semantic data models to support business reporting and self-service analytics.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is consumers of the reporting layer and self-service analytics across the organisation, with no single business function named, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting standards.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role sets reporting standards and promotes BI practice ('define KPIs and reporting standards', 'Promote BI best practices') while delivering to requirements ('Translate business requirements', 'Support production issues'), so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI appears only in the company description ('AI-powered insight'); the candidate is not expected to use or build for AI.
evidence.testing_framing: Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation and reconciliation are a responsibility the candidate performs to ensure accuracy, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear is inaccurate reports and production issues, operational reliability secondary to delivery and without compliance framing, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design and develop scalable Power BI dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Build verbs ('Design and develop', 'Design and implement') sit alongside maintenance verbs ('Build and maintain', 'Optimize', 'Support production issues', 'continuous improvements'), so mixed.
